name_reason: Already compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter, descriptor=end_handler_table. Reflects data type (table of function pointers). 'chapter'/'end' are semantic, not Ghidra address residue; no numeric ID suffix to evaluate. Name matches the binary symbol and the src definition.
purpose: Per-chapter end handler jump table: read-only array of 30 zero-arg function pointers, indexed by current chapter id, dispatched once when a chapter is switched out.
logic_summary: void (*const [30])(void) in .object2. Sole reader is main @ 0x25BF4, chapter-switch branch @ 0x25E23 (taken when data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code == 2): MOV EAX,[0x53C03] (data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id); CALL dword ptr [EAX*4 + 0x51DE9]; cdecl with no stack cleanup => zero-arg, void-return. All 30 slots decode to strictly sequential, all-distinct functions fd2_chapter_01_end (index 0) .. fd2_chapter_30_end (index 29); no shared or default slots (unlike the post-action and init tables). Pointed-to handlers live in src/field/chend1.c and chend2.c; prototypes in protos.h.
element_semantics: Each element [i] is the chapter-(i+1) end handler, a void __cdecl (void) function pointer. Verified entries: [0]=0x22EF6 fd2_chapter_01_end, [2]=0x230F2 fd2_chapter_03_end, [14]=0x239BD fd2_chapter_15_end, [29]=0x25757 fd2_chapter_30_end; full decode of all 30 entries is sequential and distinct.
